title: 429Project
summary: A small student project that trains CTGAN models on tabular data and generates synthetic samples, using SDV's metadata and evaluation utilities to score similarity between real and generated data. CTGAN is imported directly for training/sampling while SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality are run to produce a quality report.
